description:
About our brand and products:

Pandora Health is a women-first wellness company helping women and families feel better, starting with the gut. We provide-centered care through education, support and our proprietary online platform and community. Our flagship ebook, Eat Well, Live Long, Live Healthy, is a practical, gorgeous, and genuinely doable recipe guide inspired by Blue Zone principles (the world’s healthiest, longest-living communities) and tailored for real life: busy schedules, picky families, and women navigating different life stages. It’s written by women, for women, with contributions and endorsement from GI and GYN clinicians, so it’s both nourishing and grounded in medical insight.

What makes us different:

Most nutrition content is either too generic (“eat clean”) or too complicated (endless restrictions and unrealistic meal plans). We’re different because we combine:

  • Women-specific perspective (hormones, gut health, life stages, family-friendly cooking)

  • Doctor-informed credibility (GI + GYN input, practical guidance over fads)

  • Blue Zone inspiration + modern convenience (longevity principles, made doable and relevant to modern life)

  • A realistic, supportive tone - no shame, no extremes, no “perfect” eating required

This is the kind of resource people actually use, and then recommend to friends and family.

How affiliates can earn:

You will receive a free copy of our Ebook. Affiliates will then earn 15% commission on every sale you generate. You’ll receive a unique tracking link (and/or code, depending on setup) so your community gets an easy, seamless way to purchase, and you get credited for each conversion. We’ll also periodically share fresh messaging angles, seasonal promo ideas, and content prompts to help you keep conversions strong.

How to promote us:
You can promote in whatever way feels most authentic to your audience. Here are proven, high-converting ideas:

  • Instagram/TikTok Reels: “What I eat when my gut is acting up,” “This book helped me find these 3 delicious recipes that don’t trigger me,” “Blue Zone-inspired meals in 15 minutes”

  • Stories + Link Sticker: quick polls (“gut issues?” “bloating?” “cramps?”), then share the ebook link

  • Email newsletters: “My go-to wellness cookbook for busy women” + a short personal story

  • Before/after moments: “From stressed + inflamed → calmer, lighter, more consistent meals” (without making medical claims)

  • Recipe teasers: share 1 recipe preview + why it works for busy women, then link to the full ebook
    We’ll provide swipe copy, hooks, and visuals you can use immediately (or use your own from your free version of the Ebook).

• Other information:

  • Audience fit: women dealing with gut issues, inflammation, hormone shifts, chronic symptoms, and anyone who wants practical health, wellness and longevity habits without extremes

  • Brand vibe: warm, smart, hopeful, evidence-informed, and real-life doable

  • Support: we’re happy to collaborate on content ideas, bundles, special launches, giveaways, and limited-time promos to help you maximize earning

If you believe women deserve health resources that are both credible and truly usable, you’ll love partnering with Pandora Health.
payout_period: 1st of each month, payout periods negotiable.
